response.overview: Directed and produced by Mike Clum, The Sick Mind of EDP445 is a feature-length documentary examining the tumultuous career, public downfall, and personal life of former YouTube personality Bryant "EDP445" Moreland. Once a viral sensation known for his volatile Philadelphia Eagles rants and unvarnished online persona, Moreland amassed over two million subscribers before a high-profile 2021 predator sting operation exposed explicit interactions with a minor and shattered his online career.  Featuring interviews with Chris Hansen, associates, and unprecedented access to Moreland himself, the 94-minute film delves into his viral rise, the infamous "cupcake" confrontation, and his surreal present-day life. Through candid discussions about his personal relationships and shocking accounts of past incidents, the documentary offers a dark, cinematic portrait of accountability, delusion, and internet infamy.
response.tagline: The rise, fall, and disturbing reality of an internet outcast.
response.title: The Sick Mind of EDP445
